implementationSummary: Added Celery Beat hourly task mock_analytics_hourly_reconcile that reads DEMO_REFERENCE_SHOP_ID, resolves the TikTok shop key, and invokes material_analytics_precompute_sync for that shop only. Reuses #532 compute path for idempotent upsert with material webhooks. Documented Mock-mode reconciliation in workers MODULE.md per ADR-038 §5.
assumptions: DEMO_REFERENCE_SHOP_ID is a shop UUID matching #531 server binding
#532 material_analytics_precompute_sync provides shared upsert + cache refresh path
When env unset, job no-ops with structured log (safe for non-Demo deployments)
risks: Shop lookup requires DATABASE_URL at worker runtime — same as other Celery tasks
Hourly beat runs at :00 UTC; ops may tune crontab later without changing task semantics
